messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Translate literally: Amma mín og afi búa á Dalvík og ég hef komið í heimsókn á hverju ári með frænku minni. Ég man sérstaklega vel eftir að fara á fiskidaginn með þeim og frænku minni áður en það hætti og að borða jarðarberin og annað sem amma ræktar.

message.content: My mother and father live in Dalvík and I have come for a visit every year with my cousin. I especially remember going to the fishing day with them and my cousin before it stopped and eating the potatoes and other things that mother grows.
